summary.interpretation: Paired diagnostic draws at this chosen scene; conservative 95% difference interval excludes source-seed anchor. Abstain when it overlaps zero. No release or generalization claim.

paired_effect.interval_method: Conservative paired difference: simultaneous Clopper–Pearson bounds on rescue and regression probabilities; one-sided 95% nominal gate uses Bonferroni tails .025.

validity.scope: Total scene intervention effect in the gantry simulation, including instrumented policy observations. Excluded from registered statistics, nomination and training. No mid-episode fork or perception-only claim.
